crop.rationale: This is the smallest coherent crop that readably captures TeamPath’s shared multimodal input path: pathology image source, text prompt/instruction, and the immediate model-facing encoders/fusion interface. It excludes the downstream router/system outputs in panel d and the ranking/results panel e.
